biased_shapley_augmented.description: Paper Table 2: biased Shapley game augmented with the Nash strategy N. Deviation ratings should assign equal ratings to R, P, S, and N.

all_player_dev_gap.description: Maximum rating spread across both players' four augmented Shapley actions; catches methods that only equalize one player.

player_symmetry_gap.description: Maximum same-action rating mismatch between the two players in the symmetric augmented game.

clone_invariance.description: Paper Property 6: adding a clone of an existing strategy should not change the ratings of the original strategies.

all_players_max_diff.description: Maximum clone-induced rating change over all original actions for both players, not just the cloned player's visible slice.

clone_source_gap.description: Absolute rating mismatch between the added clone and its source action.

mixture_invariance.description: Paper Property 7: adding a mixed strategy should not change the original ratings, and the new strategy should inherit the corresponding mixed rating.

max_CCE_gap.description: Largest recomputed equilibrium regret gap across the base and mixed-strategy augmented games.

offset_invariance.description: Paper Property 5: adding arbitrary b_p(a_-p) offsets should not change any deviation ratings.

max_CCE_gap.description: Largest recomputed equilibrium regret gap across the base and offset-transformed games.

dominance_preserving.description: Paper Property 4: if one strategy dominates another, the dominant strategy should not receive a lower rating.

min_margin.description: Smallest rating advantage of a dominant action over its dominated counterpart; catches barely or directionally incorrect dominance handling.
